images.caption:
Armadale House - rebirth 2008. Armadale House on Bank Street, Portree was built in the 1880s. Until the end of 2007, it was the site of the hardware shop of D Stewart & Co. Stewarts had been trading in Portree since 1840, and had occupied this site for well over 100 years before closing their doors for the last time. See 674471
Now the property is being redeveloped for a number of retail and leisure uses. The two shop units on the ground floor have opened recently. On the left is 'Kilts & Krafts' (it could have been 'Cilts and Crafts', I suppose), and on the right is Carmina Gadelica, selling books, music and artists' materials.

images.caption: Sligachan Bridge on the Isle of Skye. Immediately to the left of this bridge the only road from the south branches towards Portree and Dunvegan. On the far left one can catch a glimpse of Sligachan Hotel, on the far right one can see the slope of a Red Cuillin hill. Through the central arch one can spot a part of the new road bridge. As the weather was changing from sun to fog and back in short distances and moments on that day, one can see a few faint cloud bands in the sky.
